research_question: Can a provenance-qualified knot/link atlas support independent, target-free topology observables with the symmetry, additivity, monodromy and closure structure required of a multi-operator particle taxonomy, without assigning semantic particle labels during blind analysis?
objective: Run a nonblocking phased falsification program: source qualification, static family structure, circulation-sign conjugation, additive signed-response discovery, frame/rotation monodromy, discrete involutions, parity-odd background chirality selection, independent second-U1 closure, and three-component/connector readiness. Each phase records its own evidentiary boundary and later phases may run after earlier FAIL/UNRESOLVED outcomes.
null_hypothesis: H0: topology/geometry provides no reproducible operator set beyond representation choices and universal kinematic identities; any apparent cancellation, doublet, monodromy or closure is provider-sensitive, definitionally constructed, or unsupported by dynamics-ready sources.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one preregistered operator candidate survives provider and symmetry controls while remaining independent of semantic labels, and its downstream additive/closure predictions survive held-out or source-qualified tests.
assumptions: E011 v0.3.0 is authoritative only for its declared STATIC_READY geometry/provenance boundary; it is not DYNAMICS_READY.
Global circulation sign is modeled as an independent state variable only in the conjugation lane; no physical anti-state interpretation is allowed before reveal.
Missing prior phase results lower evidence classification but never prevent execution of a later phase.
Provider seeds are not treated as independent physical replications.
The universal SO(3) double cover is a control, not a topology-specific spin result.
A second U1-like observable must be independently measured; it may not be defined from the desired closure equation.
The exact E011 source archive SHA-256 is 97cd1acbf23c102e4564f2d74fd329a2d03f32a29b8bd376ffa8b806c14246cc.
A privately committed historical axial-coupling precursor is hypothesis lineage only; it supplies no evidentiary weight and cannot close the new background-chirality phase.
A parity-even scalar potential or gravity magnitude cannot by itself select left versus right; the registered selector candidates must be parity-odd pseudoscalars.

steps.operation: P00 verifies exact E011 archive provenance and emits only anonymous topology IDs.
P01 builds robust standardized geometry features and deterministic target-free clusters.
P02 tests circulation-sign odd/even covariance; optional geometry-resolved filament probes require raw source SHA verification.
P03 ranks all anonymous knot pairs by preregistered nonnegative geometry amplitudes, discrete relative sign, provider penalty and 2+1 cancellation score.
P04 evaluates universal 2pi/4pi quaternion lift separately from knot-specific discrete frame holonomy.
P05 keeps circulation reversal, curve orientation and spatial mirror as distinct involutions and requires independent support before a two-state operator can PASS.

P06 tests parity-even gravity controls against parity-odd background pseudoscalars and verifies the induced sign reversal of an analytic axial L/R splitting. It cannot PASS the physical-mechanism subgate without a dynamics-ready background field and independently derived coupling scale.
P07 attempts no closure unless a second independently measured U1-like observable exists; definitionally constructing Y from Q and T is forbidden.
P08 evaluates additive 3-component candidates and separately checks source readiness of link/container controls.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Exact E011 archive or internal release provenance fails.
No target-free static structure reaches the preregistered clusterability threshold.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: FAIL for static family-separation phase only

falsification_criteria.criterion: A provenance-resolved filament lane violates circulation oddness or quadratic-energy evenness above 1e-11.
No pair reaches cancellation score <=0.08 with provider Wr relative spread <=0.25.
Only universal SO(3) double-cover behavior is available and no provider-repeated topology-dependent frame holonomy is resolved.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: FAIL/UNRESOLVED topology-specific monodromy; universal control remains PASS

falsification_criteria.criterion: Binary labels exist only by definition and lack an independent topology-dependent operator.
No independent second U1-like observable exists.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: UNRESOLVED closure; do not synthesize one from the closure equation

falsification_criteria.criterion: Additive cancellation exists but the requested three-component container is not STATIC_READY/DYNAMICS_READY in the source atlas.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: UNRESOLVED mechanism while preserving additive diagnostic

falsification_criteria.criterion: Parity-even controls distinguish the two chiral labels, a registered pseudoscalar fails to flip under parity, or the analytic splitting fails to swap branches under parity.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: FAIL structural gravity-chirality selector. If analytic parity passes but no dynamics-ready background/coupling source exists, physical mechanism remains UNRESOLVED.

edge_cases: Mirror conventions may differ between upstream providers; blind signed-response discovery therefore uses nonnegative geometry amplitudes plus an explicitly separate discrete state sign.
Links and open curves require component/end-point aware parsers; unsupported geometry representations remain UNRESOLVED rather than silently converted.
Provider-sensitive E011 topologies are retained with explicit spread penalties instead of being discarded post hoc.
A universal preferred timelike direction alone is not counted as a chiral selector unless an independently defined parity-odd scalar/pseudoscalar enters the coupling.
predictions: If a physical conjugation operation is circulation reversal, circulation-linear observables should be odd while quadratic energy-like observables are even.
If a topology-derived additive response exists, some anonymous pair should show provider-robust 2:1-like magnitude structure before semantic reveal.
If topology carries more than universal rigid-body monodromy, frame/state-space holonomy should vary reproducibly between anonymous objects/providers.
Any successful final closure must survive a future preregistered calibration/held-out split using independently measured operators.

If a parity-odd gravitational/vorticity background selects chirality, mirror reversal of the background must reverse the sign of the L/R splitting while parity-even scalar/magnitude controls remain invariant.
